privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use the FilmeJá platform. We're committed to transparency and respect for your data, in line with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD - Law 13.709/2018).

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
content: When you use FilmeJá, we may collect the following information:

• Account data: name, email, password (stored encrypted), and, where applicable, payment data — processed directly by our payment partners (Stripe and/or Google Play), without FilmeJá ever having access to your full card number.

• Usage and behavior data: selected genres and moods, titles viewed, liked, saved, and dismissed, clicks on streaming services, conversations with Filmin.IA, and other interactions logged to understand how you use the app.

• Device and notification data: a push identifier (Firebase Cloud Messaging token) used to send notifications, your device model/operating system, and advertising identifier (Advertising ID), when you use the Android/iOS app.
• Technical browsing data (web version): IP address, device type, browser, and cookies, used to keep you signed in and improve your experience.

sections.title: 2. Why We Collect It
content: The information we collect is used for the following purposes:
• Creating, authenticating, and managing your account on the platform;
• Generating personalized movie and TV show recommendations with the help of artificial intelligence, based on your preferences, mood, and interaction history;
• Sending relevant push notifications, such as movie-night reminders, recommendations that match your profile, and catalog updates;
• Showing ads (for free-tier users) through Google AdMob, including, where allowed by your device's privacy settings, minimally personalized ads;
• Processing Premium plan subscriptions and payments;
• Continuously improving our services, based on aggregated usage metrics;
• Complying with legal and regulatory obligations;
• Sending support communications, important notices, or updates.
We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: 3. Sharing With Third Parties
content: To operate FilmeJá, we share data with vendors that act on our behalf, always limited to what's necessary to provide the service:
• Supabase: database hosting, authentication, and storage of your account information;
• Google Firebase Cloud Messaging: delivery of push notifications in the app;
• Google AdMob: displaying ads on the free plan, which may collect your device's advertising identifier per Google's own privacy policy;
• TMDB (The Movie Database): source of the movie, show, cast, and "where to watch" data shown in the app;
• Google Gemini AI: processing of Filmin.IA's recommendations and conversations — the messages you send the assistant are processed by this service to generate its replies;
• Stripe and/or Google Play Billing: processing payments for Premium subscriptions.
Each of these partners has its own privacy policy, which we recommend you review.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and Similar Technologies
content: On the web version, we use cookies and local storage technologies (localStorage) to keep you signed in, remember device preferences, and support ad delivery. In the mobile app, equivalent on-device local storage technologies are used for the same purposes, including tracking whether the app's initial intro screens have already been shown. You can manage personalized ad permissions in your device settings (Android/iOS) at any time.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention
content: We keep your personal data for as long as your account is active, or as needed to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, including legal, accounting, or reporting obligations. Usage and event data may be kept in aggregated or anonymized form for an additional period for statistical purposes, without directly identifying you. When you delete your account, we remove or anonymize your personal data, except where retention is required by law.

sections.title: 6. Data Security
content: We use technical and organizational measures to protect your data, such as encryption in transit (HTTPS), access control through authentication, and Row Level Security policies in the database that ensure each user can only access their own information. Despite these efforts, no system is completely risk-free, and we continuously work to improve our security practices.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights (LGPD)
content: Under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law 13.709/2018), you have the right to:
• Confirm whether we process your data, and access it;
• Correct incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data;
• Request deletion, anonymization, or portability of your data;
• Withdraw consent and object to processing based on it;
• Request information about who we share your data with.
You can exercise these rights directly in the app, on the Profile screen, or by contacting us at the email address listed at the bottom of this page.

sections.title: 8. Children
content: FilmeJá is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect data from children in that age group. If we learn that we've collected data from a child under 13 without proper parental or guardian consent, we will take steps to delete it.

sections.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
content: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal and operational requirements. The last-updated date is always shown at the top of this page. In case of material changes, we may notify you through the app or by email.
